title: Convenient Capes
description: another mod I'm making because I didn't find any mods that were good enough.
body:
# Convenient Capes
I made this because I couldn't find any good cape mods that ran locally and didn't need a website for NeoForge 1.21.1 (on modrinth).

## Features:
- overrides the default cape, i.e. whatever cape you have equipped in vanilla.
- also overrides the elytra texture of the same cape.

---
currently this mod is **CLIENT-SIDE ONLY**, and doesn't show other players in the same world as you what cape you're using, so only the people using the mod can see their own custom capes, they won't be able to see the custom capes of other people in the same world as them.

but I'll add server-side support soon, making it so that everyone using the mod can see eachother's capes if they're playing together.

thanks for downloading my mod, and enjoy!
